messages:
jenna (Product): quick check — weaving customer asks into the Optimize playbook RFC. we have three scoping proposals on the table (light, balanced, aggressive). i want alignment on launch criteria + must-have acceptance tests before we freeze the PRD.

arjun (Eng-ML): +1. can we list concrete perf targets per mode? e.g., hosted P95 latency < 120ms for short seq, cost delta < 20% vs baseline for medium seq.

lina (Eng-Platform): note: platform constraints matter for caching mode; we need a fallback when prefix cache miss spike > 10k/s. otherwise we'll saturate redis layer.

sam (Solutions): customer-facing ask from Acme: want explicit guidance on when to recommend 4-bit quant vs 8-bit QAT. they care about hallucination risk for retrieval-augmented apps.

marta (Customer Success): adding: compliance customers want opt-out knobs for any caching that stores prefixes. must include KMS auditing notes in acceptance criteria.

arjun (Eng-ML): proposed acceptance checklist (draft):
- batching: autotune policy that keeps tail latency SLO (P95) under threshold across 95% of traces
- caching: transparent TTL and eviction telemetry, test sim for cache storm behavior (rps ramp)
- quantization: regression test suite (5k examples) with trained calibration + fallback to float when QA metrics drop > 2%

jenna (Product): this is great. Lina / Arjun — do we have an easy stress test that simulates cache storm? can we scope it as part of RFC or as a follow-up runbook?

lina (Eng-Platform): we have a harness but currently it's infra-heavy. i'd like the RFC to include a lightweight sim (locally reproducible) and a separate infra smoke test that eng-sre runs pre-launch.

arjun (Eng-ML): i can add a small harness script. pseudo:```
# cache-storm-sim.sh
for i in {1..10000}; do curl -sS -X POST "$REDWOOD_ENDPOINT/generate" -d '{"input":"rand-${i}"}' &
done
wait
```
we should include expected redis metrics and guidance on what failure looks like (latency spike, queue growth).

sam (Solutions): for the quant guidance, recommend we surface an empirical tradeoff table in the PRD: accuracy delta vs cost delta vs memory. customers love a simple matrix.

marta (Customer Success): also add a short blurb for sales: wording for when to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted with Optimize enabled. helps avoid scope creep in demos.

jenna (Product): OK action items then: 1) arjun to author acceptance checklist + small harness (due 3 business days) 2) lina to add platform failure modes and minimal sim instructions (3 business days) 3) sam to draft the tradeoff matrix and customer wording (5 business days) 4) marta to compile compliance/scoping bullets (2 business days). i'll pull into the PRD and push RFC draft for review by EOW.

lina (Eng-Platform): small request: in the PRD please mark any items that will require infra budget (redis, storage, extra egress). we need cost approvals before launch.

arjun (Eng-ML): noted. also: edge-case to call out — models with dynamic kv cache (interactive long-chat) need cache-key hygiene; we should recommend deterministic prefix hashing.

sam (Solutions): can we add at least one customer scenario in the PRD illustrating a failure and the rollback plan? e.g., heavy cache miss -> degrade to smaller batch size -> switch to float model fallback. customers want to see concrete rollback steps.

jenna (Product): yes — i'll include a short runbook stub and a rollback flowchart. final ask: reviewers, please give tight feedback on acceptance criteria (don't conflate wish-list with must-have). aim to have PRD + RFC ready for a 30-min review on Thursday. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy check passed for infra/harness branch (build 202).

arjun (Eng-ML): thanks everyone — i'll drop the checklist + script in the RFC thread later today.

marta (Customer Success): thanks — i'll add the compliance bullets and short sales blurb after lunch.

jenna (Product): perfect. closing loop here. if anyone sees a blocker ping me directly.
